concerns.text: FR-001 (verify core columns and derive missing scores) has no dedicated task. Existing tasks T003a, T004, T007, T008 do not perform core‑column validation or score derivation.
FR-002 (derive valence scores) is not covered by any task. Task T008 creates base data classes; no task implements the CPU‑only emotion classifier or lexical dictionary derivation.
FR-003 (associational framing) is absent from the task list. No task adds the required `caution_note`/`limitation_note` to model results.
FR-004 (multiple‑comparison correction) is not represented by any task. There is no task performing Benjamini‑Hochberg or Bonferroni correction.
FR-005 (VIF computation and flagging) lacks a corresponding task. No task computes VIF or writes `state/vif_flag.json`.
FR-006 (α‑sweep sensitivity analysis) is not covered. No task performs the sensitivity sweep or writes `reports/sensitivity_analysis.csv`.
FR-007 (external validation of derived scores) is listed in the plan but no task creates `state/score_validation.json` or performs the validation step.
FR-008 (power‑analysis checkpoint) is absent. No task computes required sample size or writes `state/power_check.json`.
FR-009 (confounding diagnostics) is not represented. No task generates `state/confound_check.json`.
SC-001 (data ingestion completeness metric) is not covered. No task records or verifies linkage percentages against the design target.
SC-002 (model convergence success rate) has no task tracking the proportion of successful fits within three optimizer attempts.
SC-003 (final PDF contains required artifacts) is missing. No task guarantees creation of `reports/final_report.pdf` with the specified contents.
SC-004 (artifact hashing for versioning) is not present. No task records SHA‑256 hashes for all generated artifacts.
Task T018a claims to produce `data/processed/ingest_metrics.json` but the verification step is missing; this leaves SC-001 unverified.
Task T009 configures logging but does not include the required verification that `code/logs/pipeline.log` exists and follows the specified format.
